name: Curious Trinkets
summary: Ashe Amberhall in Farholde Keep asks you to learn about the cult in Sunnyglade by bringing her its enchanted charms. She believes the tokens can reveal something of the cult’s magic.

sections.title: A Request at Farholde
sections.body: Ashe Amberhall wants to study the cult in Sunnyglade, where magical skill earns some members favor and tokens. She believes the charms carry cultist magic. So you are asked to bring her charms taken from Twilight Shadowmancers and Twilight Neophytes.

faq.q: Who is asking for the charms?
faq.answer: Ashe Amberhall, at Farholde Keep, wants to examine the cult’s charms.

faq.q: Why does Ashe want the charms?
faq.answer: Ashe wants to learn more about the cult in Sunnyglade and believes its charms hold cultist magic.
They are tokens given to cult members with an affinity for magic, then imbued with cultist magic.
Twilight Shadowmancers and Twilight Neophytes in Sunnyglade carry the charms Ashe seeks.

angles.text: As a druid, Ashe sees you as someone who might help her investigate the cult in Sunnyglade.
